Name: Em's Mole Scarecrows
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Replacing the scarecrows with little moles sitting between the crops
There are 15 mole options, and four seasonal ground options
Each type can be assigned to the scarecrow, deluxe scarecrow or the 8 rarecrows
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][i][i]
[/i][/i]
﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Download and unzip "Em's Mole Scarecrows CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xCVVg6w9/Mole-Config.gif[/img]

To choose a different type of mole or ground:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Ems mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Mole[/color]" with the name of the type of mole you like
Replace "[color=#e69138]DarkDirt[/color]" with the dirt type you like
There is a [i]reference.png[/i] with all the options in the folder

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
Download and unzip "Em's Mole Scarecrows AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the paint bucket selected, right-click on the scarecrow and choose the texture
Enjoy!

Note: Only the dark ground option is available when using the AT file

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1: Recolour of mole nr 5 to match the yellow braids of the rarecrow.
Update 1.2: An AlternativeTexture file is now available
Update 1.3: Resolved size issue of mole nr 5
Update 1.4: Included update keys and minor AT script fixes
[i]Update 1.5: Redesign and config option for the dirt and five new moles[/i][/i]
